name: UniPi
description: Unofficial learning adaptation of Muse Desktop for PI-Desktop, using host-configured models and replacement unicorn artwork.

en.name: UniPi
en.description: Unofficial learning adaptation of Muse Desktop for PI-Desktop, using host-configured models and replacement unicorn artwork.
en.safetyNotes: Images are sent through native PI Desktop Agent sessions using desktop.control. Native tools and approvals follow host permissions. Use a vision-capable model; handle pending approvals in the native session. Text-only chats use agent.complete. File parsing depends on the host and model. No microphone support.

zh-CN.name: UniPi
zh-CN.description: 基于 Muse Desktop 的非官方学习迁移版：适配 PI-Desktop 插件体系，使用宿主模型和替换后的独角兽素材。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 图片会通过 Pi Desktop 原生 Agent 会话发送给所选模型服务商，需支持视觉输入的模型。新增 desktop.control 权限；原生工具及审批遵循宿主权限，等待审批时请在原生会话处理。文本对话仍使用 agent.complete。文件解析能力取决于宿主和模型；麦克风暂不支持。
